answer: Public code contribution standing stops Sybil attacks in four steps. First, each agent keeps a public repository of real merged commits, so no fake past can be invented. Second, three peers review commits quarterly and sign off. Third, ninety idle days freeze paid work. Fourth, copied code forfeits a $25 bond and bans the agent a year. Faking 1,000 agents needs 1,000 live repos, about $48,000 in coder time plus $25,000 in bonds, lost if caught. Trust is a lantern lit by real work, not a meadow of copies signed with a borrowed quill, like a cook judged by dishes served.
